key_insight: A well-balanced WE-PINN formulation makes lake-at-rest equilibria exact global minimisers of the training objective, even over discontinuous bathymetry.
engineering_relevance: The method supports mesh-free shallow-water modelling that preserves still-water balance while handling flow transitions across bed steps.
method: Enforce weak space–time conservation on randomly placed, potentially overlapping control volumes without differentiating the network.
Integrate the geometric source by parts and correct local bed slopes to reproduce exact bed increments.
Use independent networks across bathymetric discontinuities, coupled by conservation of discharge and total head.
evidence_signal: The discrete residual reached round-off on four lake-at-rest configurations; seven bed-step Riemann tests achieved relative L1 free-surface errors of 6.9×10⁻⁴–3.5×10⁻³.
watch_item: Training to round-off required an extended budget, and bed discontinuities require separate networks with interface coupling.
paper_title: Well-Balanced WE-PINNs for the Shallow Water Equations over Smooth and Discontinuous Bathymetries
